prova.explica: Against bots, with no outside service: before your request goes out, your device does a short calculation. Of your device and your network, only a scrambled digest is kept, and it is gone within a day.
prova.fazendo: Your device is doing the anti-bot calculation…
prova.fazendoAntes: Your device is doing a short calculation before sending…
prova.demorando: It is taking longer than usual (there are many requests right now). You can wait: the calculation keeps going.

erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests from this network this hour. Try again later.
erros.porta_cheia: Alumia received many requests this hour. Try again in a little while.
erros.rede_barrada: From this network you cannot create an account or ask to join right now.
erros.desafio_vencido: The calculation took too long and expired. Try again.
erros.email_nao_confirmado: Confirm your e-mail before asking to join: the link is in your inbox.
erros.cadastro_fechado: Sign-up is closed at the moment. Come back soon.
erros.senha_fraca: That password will not do. Pick a longer one that you do not use anywhere else.
erros.sem_servico: We could not reach the server right now. Try again in a little while.
erros.captcha: Cloudflare's anti-robot check has not finished or did not pass. Wait for its box to confirm and try again.
erros.falha: That did not work right now. Try again in a little while.

pagina.texto: Someone who is already inside sent you this invitation. It takes your request to the screening, like any other: it does not approve you by itself.
pagina.sigilo: The screening only sees that the request came with an invitation, never from whom. Once it decides, not even that mark remains.
pagina.guardado: The invitation is kept only on this device, for up to 7 days, until your request goes out.
pagina.criar: Create an account and ask to join
pagina.invalidoTitulo: This invitation is no longer valid
pagina.invalido: It expired, was already used or was cancelled. You can still ask to join without an invitation: the screening reads every request.
pagina.pedirSem: Ask to join without an invitation
pagina.semConferir: We could not check the invitation right now. It stays on this device and goes along with your request; if it is no longer valid, the request goes without it.

passos.texto: E-mail and password. Never a phone number.
A codename and why you want to join. The invitation goes along.
People from the coordination and mediation decide. Once approved, you set up the authenticator app and come in.

meus.texto: Send the link to someone you know. The invitation leads to the screening and does not approve anyone by itself; Alumia does not keep who invited whom.
meus.novo: Copy the link now: it is shown only this once. Valid for 7 days, until {data}.
meus.nota: A used invitation leaves the list and the database right away: Alumia keeps neither which one it was nor who asked to join with it.
meus.acabaram: This month's invitations are used up. There will be more next month.
meus.desligados: Invitations are turned off by the coordination right now.
meus.soDentro: Only people already inside Alumia can create invitations.
meus.erro: That did not work right now. Try again in a little while.

triagem.explica: The screening does not know from whom. The mark disappears once the request is decided.

redeBarrada.entrar: You can't sign in from this network right now.
redeBarrada.aviso: You can't request this e-mail from this network right now.
